channel.title: Vanta news
channel.description: Release posts for Vanta, a free Minecraft Java launcher for Windows and macOS.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.7: find instances by their notes
item.description: Ctrl K now finds your instances by name or by anything in their notes, like a seed or a server IP.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.6: check mods from the crash card
item.description: After a crash, one button checks the mods of the instance that crashed. Turned-off mods can be turned back on, Home shows playtime this week, and the crash helper knows four more crashes.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.5: one-click fixes for mod problems
item.description: The mod check can now fix the common problems for you, runs before joining servers too, and the crash card links to a searchable list of fixes.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.4: a mod check before you play, playtime and notes
item.description: Vanta now spots broken mod setups before Minecraft starts, counts your playtime, keeps notes per instance and lets you browse mods offline.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.3: copy your mods to another version
item.description: Set up a new Minecraft version in one click: Vanta adds your mods, shaders and packs to another instance, each downloaded for that version.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.2: a downloads panel, instance names and cape previews
item.description: Pause, resume or cancel Minecraft downloads from one panel, give your instances their own names, and try capes and elytra on the 3D skin.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.1: server favourites, a logs viewer and shader previews
item.description: Star your favourite servers, search the game log, flip through screenshots full size, and see shader and resource pack previews before you install.

item.title: Vanta 1.6.0: a home dashboard, modpacks and world backups
item.description: PLAY opens with a dashboard, Modrinth modpacks install in one click with every file hash-checked, and worlds get one-click backups. Plus a crash helper, appearance settings and a native Mac window.

item.title: Vanta for Mac now opens in its own window
item.description: Vanta 1.5.2 for macOS runs in a native Mac window with normal menus and shortcuts, and never opens your web browser.
